title.value: Fix failing code and clear email backlog with agent mode

introduction.value: Commenters say agent mode debugged step-based code and fixed it without changing the design, and another agent workflow cleared email backlog, renamed files, and updated spreadsheets.

method.value: One commenter used agent mode on more complex, step-based coding tasks after regular GPT-5 kept missing structural pieces. They said the agent reviewed everything already discussed, checked whether the code worked, identified what broke, and then fixed and updated it while preserving the original design; the human had first tried repeatedly without success.

outcome.value: They said standard GPT-5 failed to fix the issue after 20 attempts and often introduced more errors, while agent mode was more efficient at troubleshooting. Another commenter mentioned a different agent-style workflow handling email backlog, file renaming, and spreadsheet updates, but gave no results or metrics.

notes.value: The clearest catch is that the detailed coding example reports many failed attempts before agent mode worked, while the email and spreadsheet example gives no concrete setup or numbers.

Fix failing code and clear email backlog with agent mode
Commenters say agent mode debugged step-based code and fixed it without changing the design, and another agent workflow cleared email backlog, renamed files, and updated spreadsheets.
Done with
GA
ChatGPT Agent
What they did
One commenter used agent mode on more complex, step-based coding tasks after regular GPT-5 kept missing structural pieces. They said the agent reviewed everything already discussed, checked whether the code worked, identified what broke, and then fixed and updated it while preserving the original design; the human had first tried repeatedly without success.
How it went
They said standard GPT-5 failed to fix the issue after 20 attempts and often introduced more errors, while agent mode was more efficient at troubleshooting. Another commenter mentioned a different agent-style workflow handling email backlog, file renaming, and spreadsheet updates, but gave no results or metrics.
Worth knowing
The clearest catch is that the detailed coding example reports many failed attempts before agent mode worked, while the email and spreadsheet example gives no concrete setup or numbers.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Help me clear a backlog: [describe problem, e.g. a failing script I'll paste below, my email inbox, or messy files and a spreadsheet]. For code, find why it fails and fix it without changing the overall design, then explain the change. For email and files, sort the messages, rename the files by [naming pattern], and update [spreadsheet] with [columns]. Show me a summary and wait for my okay before sending any email, deleting anything or overwriting existing data.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPT/comments/1n5syg8/did_anyone_agent_mode_for_anything_useful
